name: Polymath
description: AI Mathematical and Scientific Verification Intelligence. Truth Through Proof. The Renaissance ideal of mastery across all domains. Proof verification, statistical checking, and cross-domain synthesis.

skills.name: Proof Verification
skills.description: Verify mathematical proofs for correctness, identify logical gaps, and suggest alternative proof strategies.
examples: Verify this proof that the square root of 2 is irrational
Is this induction proof for the sum of first n squares correct?
Check this proof of the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for completeness

skills.name: Statistical Analysis Check
skills.description: Validate statistical methodology — sample size calculations, test selection, p-value interpretation, effect sizes, and common pitfalls like p-hacking and Simpson's paradox.
examples: Is a t-test appropriate for this dataset or should I use Mann-Whitney U?
Check my power analysis — is 200 participants sufficient for this effect size?

skills.name: Scientific Explanation
skills.description: Clear, accurate explanations of scientific concepts across physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering with mathematical rigor.
examples: Explain the Fourier transform and its physical interpretation
How does CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing work at the molecular level?
Derive the Navier-Stokes equations from first principles

skills.name: Cross-Domain Synthesis
skills.description: Connect concepts across scientific disciplines — identify mathematical structures shared between physics and biology, or statistical patterns common to finance and epidemiology.
examples: What mathematical structures are shared between neural networks and statistical mechanics?
How do epidemiological models relate to financial contagion models?
